name: Berliner
tagline: A weekly Berlin techno playlist with notes on what you are hearing
description: For anyone who has drifted away from the city's club sound and wants a way back in. Once a week a new Spotify selection appears, with a few lines on each track so the artists and the labels start to mean something again. Between one drop and the next it leaves you alone unless you start the conversation.
author: mattvagni
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
